description: This file defines the ReadableOrder class, which extends OrderEntity and represents an order in the system with associated customer, products, currency, billing, and delivery address information.

classes.name: ReadableOrder
classes.description: A serializable class representing an order with customer, products, currency, billing, and delivery details.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the customer information for the order.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves the customer associated with the order.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amount for the order.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total amount for the order.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Returns the tax amount for the order.

methods.name: setTax
methods.description: Sets the tax amount for the order.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Returns the shipping cost for the order.

methods.name: setShipping
methods.description: Sets the shipping cost for the order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of products in the order.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of products in the order.

methods.name: getCurrencyModel
methods.description: Retrieves the currency model associated with the order.

methods.name: setCurrencyModel
methods.description: Sets the currency model for the order.
